_comment: __text baseline for the binary-size CI gate (see devkit size check and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). Measured osx-arm64, 2026-09-11, on mojo 1.1.0.dev2026090705. Regenerate after an intentional size change with: pixi run -e dev python -m devkit size check --update. Re-recorded 2026-09-11 for the storage seam: ParquetScanOperator now holds ParquetFile[DynSource] rather than pinning the local backend, so a query plan can scan s3:// and not only a path. That is the whole of the change -- query_cli +50,048 (+1.64%), being the erasure ladder plus the OpenDAL backend linking into any binary that scans Parquet. Every other gate moved by less than 800 bytes, which is noise: query_streaming, query_join and query_expr2_streaming are byte-identical. The alternative, if the 50 KB ever matters, is a -D MARROW_OPENDAL switch selecting a one-arm variant; see marrow/io/dispatch.mojo.
